**Member (job-fit):** anchored promote — achromatic surfaces + steel accent + Familjen hold for Library without porting landing atmosphere (Plan § Atmosphere-boundary).

**Defender brief:** narrows brand-fit kill — shared materials path satisfies family resemblance without particles; concedes craft kill on dashed frame unless optional.
